identity.attempts.unavailable: Codes cannot be checked right now. Try again in a moment.
identity.code.invalid: The code is not valid: it is wrong, expired, already used or replaced by a newer one, or it was not sent to this account. Ask for a new one.
identity.email.invalid: The email address is missing or is not a valid address.
identity.name.invalid: The name needs a given name and, together with the family name, at most 60 characters, with no link (http, www. or ://).
identity.password.breached: This password appears in a public list of leaked passwords. Choose another one.
identity.password.too_long: The password is too long: it can have at most {max} characters.
identity.password.too_short: The password is too short: it needs at least {min} characters.
identity.session.invalid: The session is missing, expired or was revoked, or the request sent its session cookie twice. Log in again.
